When the aliens interbred with the Mayans, they produced a form of life they could inhabit. They fluctuated between a human and iguana appearance in chameleon-like abilities, a perfect vehicle for transforming into world leaders.

"Those who have seen a reptilian-type ethereal figure enveloping and following around humans and locking into them in those lower two chakra points, vortex points, for me, is possession. The more |' ve understood this, the more |' ve realized just how many people, particularly these bloodlines, are actually controlled by these other-dimensional forces,
and while we appear to be seeing a president or a banking leader in a physical form, the actual point of control is beyond that and overshadowing it, and on some occasion people see that overshadowing entity."

One wonders whether such a defense— "The reptile made me do

it!" —will some day be used in a court of law.
